title: Anthropic’s journey from start-up to stock market giant | Infographics
summary: From its founding in 2021 to a record-breaking Nasdaq debut, tracing Anthropic’s journey into one of the world’s most valuable AI companies
llm_summary: Anthropic, founded in 2021, quickly rose from a stealthy AI start‑up to a publicly traded heavyweight, debuting on the Nasdaq with a record‑setting valuation. The company’s rapid growth—driven by its advanced language‑model research and high‑profile partnerships—has positioned it among the world’s most valuable AI firms.
